correctness.rationale: On the probability space (c0, μ), invariance gives P_n X_n = (B_w^n X)_0 with law X_0. Bounded products on an infinite subsequence and sample-wise coordinate decay make that common law a point mass at zero, by convergence in distribution. Nonvanishing products and a countable intersection then make the entire vector zero. The fixed-vector recursion forces x_n=x_0/P_n, giving exactly the claimed divergence condition. When products diverge, the product-disk coding is uniformly approximated by its coordinate truncations, hence continuous into the supremum norm and injective with compact image; the exact intertwining carries iid shift invariance and mixing to that image. Finite-coordinate event approximation in probability extends block independence to all Borel events. Nonatomicity follows from the zeroth marginal. The topological mixing criterion also follows by hitting finite-support targets from finite-support inputs with a tail correction y_j P_j/P_{n+j}; conversely hitting an open neighborhood with zeroth coordinate bounded away from zero from arbitrarily small norm balls forces |P_n|→∞. These arguments apply to real and complex scalars without a lower bound on individual weights. The nested frozen checks/verify_examples.py was inspected, not executed; it tests prefix algebra, not invariant-law necessity.
